channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Florida primaries set for governor and Senate races
item.description: Voters in three states head to the polls Tuesday, with Florida selecting nominees for governor and Senate.

item.title: Ship attacked in Strait of Hormuz, casualty reported, UKMTO says
item.description: President Donald Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28, with massive joint U.S.-Israeli strikes.

item.title: Florida to carry out 13th execution this year in nation's busiest death chamber
item.description: A Florida man convicted of fatally shooting his estranged wife and wounding his mother-in-law is scheduled for execution.

item.title: Kushner says Iran not interested in deal that "makes sense" for U.S.
item.description: The president's son-in-law and envoy said Trump is focused on exerting economic pressure on Tehran.
